items.question: What is Zentlet?
items.answer: A personal finance web app to record income and expenses in seconds and see your monthly balance, no spreadsheets.

items.question: How does it know which category each expense belongs to?
items.answer: As you type, Zentlet recognizes the type and any categories whose name appears in the text. If that's not enough, AI suggests a category from the ones you created. You can always change it.

items.question: Can I use my currency?
items.answer: Yes. You can choose soles (S/), dollars ($) or euros (€) in the settings, and the whole app will show that symbol.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No. Zentlet works in your phone or computer browser; you just need to sign in.

items.question: Who can see my transactions?
items.answer: Only you. Every request requires your session and returns only the transactions and categories in your account.
